inputs.excluded: shipped order label lists, stored maps, pivot sets, expected dimensions
inputs.transport: TU=z^{-1} TB, TW=z^{-4} Sym^2(TB), TB=diag(z^3,1,z^4,z^3) with TB[E0,E1]=z C

normalization: A graded monomial lifts by the triangular transport. On each lower line of base degree beta the finite representative keeps only z >= beta+1. Global sections 0 <= z <= beta of that line, when any exist, stay in their own basis summand.
